official_stats.role: Historical names and areas. It does not identify individual photo positions or prove current condition.

method: Use relative placement and visible roof outline. Release dates do not imply capture dates. The footprint overlay is approximate and is not a geometry correction. World Imagery zoom 20 returned a no-data placeholder and was excluded.
